source_text: הִנְ/נִ֥י עֹשֶׂ֛ה אֶת כָּל מְעַנַּ֖יִ/ךְ בָּ/עֵ֣ת הַ/הִ֑יא וְ/הוֹשַׁעְתִּ֣י אֶת הַ/צֹּלֵעָ֗ה וְ/הַ/נִּדָּחָה֙ אֲקַבֵּ֔ץ וְ/שַׂמְתִּי/ם֙ לִ/תְהִלָּ֣ה וּ/לְ/שֵׁ֔ם בְּ/כָל הָ/אָ֖רֶץ בָּשְׁתָּֽ/ם־־־־׃
english_snapshot: Behold[a], at that time I will deal with all your oppressors, and I will save the lame and gather the outcast[d][c][b], and I will make them a praise and a name in every land where they were put to shame.

signals.text: The final phrase is difficult Hebrew; it may also be understood more literally as 'in their shame.' The translation follows the contextual sense, 'where they were put to shame.'
